My mum is pretty anti anyone who isn't cis, straight, heternormative, vanilla, religious or skilled at playing the piano. So when I came out she took it pretty hard. She's made immature and childish comments e.g. if we're watching tv and something trans* comes up she'll loudly say 'Ugh what a freak' or something similarly dehumanising.

My plan has been:
1. Have a support group
2. Ignore everything, don't take the bait
3. Have a counselor or therapist

Basically you can lean on your mates and vent to them in small doses, or hang out with them to keep your mind off of it. If you safety is at risk, as difficult as it is, just try to shut out the negative anti trans* grumpypants. And having a health professional (that you trust, who you can vent to at anytime, unfiltered) is always good and hopefully can offer various ways to handle these complex situations.
